title: Opening for tissues is just too small--they rip
text: Opening for tissues is just too small--they rip. The hole in the nose through which you pull tissues is simply too small and about half of the tissues tear. I think it may be intended to be mounted on the wall, in which case you're actually pulling the tissue out and down, which would probably work better--but who mounts a tissue box on the wall??
